evidence.note: Opening menu offers real intents (Grapple control Collar-and-elbow 58%, Set up Climb, Safe offense kick/punch, Reset) — early trade-offs exist.
One-sided snowball: Hall Superplex "Hitman takes 29 damage" drops player to HP [37,127]; by T49 player is at 1 HP while Hall still ~110.

Grapple-control streak: Collar-and-elbow chosen despite note "repeat loops lose steam"; same intent dominates long stretches (telemetry move_repetition_rate 0.5333; 14/10/13-turn Grapple control streaks).
Player floors at 1 HP for 72 turns (T48–T119) while Hall keeps dealing Superplex damage that cannot finish; no comeback window until late chip-down — pacing fails gate (119 outside [8,40]).
Late climax only: Sharpshooter submission after T118 failed get-up; near_fall_count 0 across entire match — finish without prior pin drama.
Groggy clearly a modifier, not a position: "Hitman is GROGGY — power moves and finishers are live!" with positions STANDING/STANDING and groggy[true,false].
Recovery options labeled Reset / recover (Shake the cobwebs 72%, Desperation strike 58%) with note "clear the haze before they punish you" — status → choice alignment is readable.
single_choice_turns=8: when grounded, only Fight to your feet (e.g. T9/T13/T57) — honest but high friction; still not a hidden-move case.

Pin visible when legal: Finish "Cover — pinfall attempt" (pin) plus Sharpshooter 83%; curation_pin_visible true. Sharpshooter note "match-ending swing" can still be misread as win% rather than apply%.
Mid-match sameyness: player keeps Collar-and-elbow while HP bleeds 4→1; log uniqueness 0.368 and 22× "Hitman: Collar-and-elbow tie-up." kill curiosity.
One spark worth replaying differently: at 1 HP, "Hitman reverses the razor's edge — only 2 damage, and turns the tables!" — rare drama in a slog.
119-turn submission win after endless grapple/counter loops; gates_passed false — too long to want another queue without a pacing fix.

stickiness.rematch_reason: Match overstays badly (119 turns, 72 at 1 HP) with collar/counter spam; a few highlights cannot salvage the urge to queue again.
stickiness.next_experiment: Replay seed 102 with methodical: after first successful ground (e.g. Hip toss pattern) prioritize damage/Finish over Collar-and-elbow; also check whether CPU ever covers when opponent is at 1 HP and GROUNDED (T56/T90 Superplex).

evidence.note: Strong early beat: Straight right + "Hitman is GROGGY — power moves and finishers are live!"
Finisher reverse at death's door: Razor's Edge miss → "turns the tables!" — high drama, but no pin/near-fall follow-through.
Big spot lands: Superplex "Hall takes 30 damage" with GROUNDED/GROUNDED; one of few state-shifting payoffs in the back half.

Submission finish_sequence delays (1.0s, 1.5s, 0.0): hooks in → reaches for daylight → cinched deeper → taps → SUBMISSION. Closing juice is good; middle drowned by 18× "Hall snaps off grapple counter — Hitman takes 5 damage." and near_fall_count 0.

top_issues.summary: Pacing collapse: turn_count 119 (gate fail), player stuck at 1 HP for 72 turns while damage cannot end the match; CPU Superplexes at T56/T90 never convert to covers (near_fall_count 0).
top_issues.suggested_area: finish urgency when opponent is critical / CPU pin logic

top_issues.summary: Collar-and-elbow ↔ Grapple counter loop dominates (move_repetition_rate 0.5333; long Grapple control streaks) despite UI warning "repeat loops lose steam."
top_issues.suggested_area: grapple steam / anti-loop scoring; aggressive policy variety

top_issues.summary: log_uniqueness_ratio 0.368 with highly repeated counter/tie-up lines flattens the middle of a very long match; only late Sharpshooter sequence restores payoff feel.
top_issues.suggested_area: log phrasing variety; earlier finish pressure

top_issues.summary: Eight single-choice Fight to your feet turns and Sharpshooter "83%" / "match-ending swing" wording risk apply-vs-win confusion.
top_issues.suggested_area: grounded choice variety; submission apply% labeling
